parts.label: (a)
parts.official_mark_scheme_text: M1: use the correct product rule. A1: obtain a correct derivative, e.g. dy/dx = e^(2x) + 2xe^(2x) − 5. A1 AG: equate the derivative to zero and obtain α = (1/2)ln(5/(1 + 2α)); working must show e^(2x) = 5/(1 + 2x) or ln(e^(2x)) = ln(5/(1 + 2x)), and the final relation must use α rather than x. [Total: 3]

parts.label: (b)
parts.official_mark_scheme_text: M1: calculate a relevant expression, or a pair of expressions, at x = 0.4 and x = 0.5; attempt both and have one correct. A1: complete the argument with correct values, e.g. 0.4 < 0.5108 and 0.5 > 0.458, or f(0.4) = −0.1108 < 0 and f(0.5) = 0.042 > 0; using the original derivative, values −0.994 and 0.437 are accepted. [Total: 2]

parts.label: (c)
parts.official_mark_scheme_text: M1: use α_(n+1) = (1/2)ln(5/(1 + 2α_n)) correctly at least twice anywhere in the process, obtaining one value and substituting it to obtain a second. A1: final answer 0.47. A1: show sufficient iterations to 4 d.p. to justify 0.47 to 2 d.p., or a sign change on (0.465, 0.475); accepted sequences include 0.4, 0.5108, 0.4528, 0.4823, 0.4670, 0.4749; 0.45, 0.4838, 0.4663, 0.4753, 0.4707, 0.4730; or 0.5, 0.4581, 0.4795, 0.4685, 0.4742. Allow self-correction. SC B1 for unsupported 0.47. [Total: 3]
